name: Loupe
summary: A bridal mehndi artist's work in a black room, lit one piece at a time: a real finished palm in a case with a magnifier, and "Show me" rings the name hidden in it. Then the bride from the wrist down (chooda, kaleere, haath phool, never her face), her packages as a ruled list, is my date free, the guest sum in very large numerals, and natural henna with the NHS line. Black ground, bone ink, links in the orange of a fresh stain and buttons in the deep rust of a dark one; gold only from the jewellery in the photographs. Rozha One very large, Source Serif 4 for reading. For henna and mehndi artists.
